items.title: VOLUNTARY ANNOUNCEMENT INVESTMENT IN THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE HIGH-END MSAP PRECISION PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD PROJECT
items.snippet: to keep the shareholders and potential investors of the Company informed of the latest business development of the Company.
